'''Selonians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends |species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and were large musteline [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] with long, flexible spines.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I won't have to warn you to take the Selonians seriously, because you'll know to do that five seconds after you see one. They are big and strong and quick, the average adult a bit taller than me. Most humans think they are a very refined-looking species. They're bipeds like humans and Drall, but they have long, slender bodies, and they can go on all fours if they want to. They probably evolved from some sort of active, nimble, swimming mammals. They have sleek, short fur and long, pointed faces with bristly whiskers. And very sharp teeth, and long tails just right for whapping you if you don't behave. They live underground mostly, and they are very good swimmers.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Selonian_UAA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Selonian]]
This fur-covered, sleek and powerful species were [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] who were believed to have descended from aquatic mammals.<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> They were furry bipeds who stood at an average height of two meters tall making them taller than most [[Human/Legends|Humans]] with slightly shorter legs and arms.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> In fact, adult Selonians were capable of standing between 1.8 meters to 2.2. meters tall with the female members of the species being larger. Their bodies were covered by a sleek brown or black fur and they normally did not wear clothing on their homeworld. However, when working or visiting elsewhere, they wore the appropriate clothing or outfits.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Their long bodies were equally comfortable walking on either two legs or on all four.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> On two legs, they were able to reach a base speed of 10 meters a second though were capable of reaching 12 meters per second on all four which was the same level of speed they were capable of accomplishing when swimming in water.<ref name="UAA" />

The half meter long tails served as a counterbalance for their bodies when standing upright.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> These tails were equally capable of being used as potent bludgeoning weapons in combat.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Short glossy hair covered their bodies which was usually brown or black in color. At the end of their paw-like hands were retractable claws which not only gave them the capacity to dig but also made them excellent climbers. They had long pointed faces with bristly whiskers as well as long teeth.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Selonians were able to see 20 meters in the dark with their dark-vision traits being black and white only. They also were able to see twice as far in dim lighting with them capable of distinguishing color and detail under such conditions.<ref name="UAA" />

Selonians were capable of living over 75 years of age with specific range during their growth to adulthood. Those between 1-8 years were considered children whilst 9-14 were young adults and 15-35 age were adults. A Selonian between the ages 36-55 were considered middle aged whilst those being 56-74 were held to be old and any older than 75 were considered venerable.<ref name="UAA" />

Most Selonians were infertile females. One in every hundred was male, and one in every five hundred were fertile females.

==Society and culture==
===Psychology===
{{Quote|The agreed-upon we do at once. The inevitable can take a little while.|An old Selonian saying|<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>}}
Despite the massive starship traffic to the Corellian shipyards, many visitors and even some native Corellians knew very little of the Selonians and their distinctive unique alien culture.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> In mindset, they were a thoroughly grounded and serious race who were primarily concerned with the safety of their people. This meant that the protection of their family [[Den (Selonian)|dens]] and their species as a whole was a chief concern. The basis for this line of thinking was because they viewed that the needs of the society outweighed the needs of the individual.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> To those unaware of the deeper intricacies of the race, the Selonians appeared as an outgoing, friendly and charitable species. However, their interests rarely went beyond securing the good of their respective den.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

They also had a deep psychological need to reach a consensus when taking action.<ref name="UAA" /> As individual Selonians felt that the actions of an individual impacted an entire den, they refused to lie as they believed such an act was a crime similar to murder.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

===Behavior===
====Social structure====
{{Quote|Chances are the only ones you'll ever see are going to be sterile females, and it's always a sterile female who's the boss. All their males, and all the females who can have children, have to stay at home, in the dens, all the time."|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC" />}}
It was known that the Selonians did not recognize relations in the same manner as most Human cultures;<ref name="AE" /> Despite their mammalian appearance, the social structure of a Selonian family was more similar to [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] races as they possessed a eusocial society.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

Selonians made their massive dwellings and intricate tunnels underground with their sharp claws.<ref name="AE" /> The underground nature of their existence meant that the Selonians suffered from agoraphobia and were more comfortable in confined spaces compared to open environments.<ref name="UAA" /> Selonian dens consisted of a single fertile female who was the Queen<ref name="TEGtAS" /> or [[den mother]],<ref name="Selonian Uprising" /> a few fertile males and a large number of infertile females.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

The Queen and few fertile males were responsible for siring all members of the den.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Within the den were sub-groupings known as [[sept]]s that were offspring fathered by the same fertile male.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Females born of the same father and thus were members of the same sept were genetically identical.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The Queen herself was capable of being pregnant five times a year where they gave birth to five or more children.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Despite their importance, the fertile males were treated scornfully as holding little use beyond breeding<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> and at best as prized breeding stock. Thus, a rare group had formed amongst the fertile males that attempted to promote breeder rights.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

[[File:Selonian_society-SoF.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A Selonian Queen and her entourage]]
The much more common element within their society were the sterile females who performed all the other functions of Selonian life.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The breeding arrangements made by the Queens kept each den as a close knit operation with each sterile female being trained specific duties.<ref name="AE" /> Some were, in fact, responsible for both the males' and the Queen's safety. Den members were responsible for keeping the fertile Queen away from harm and protecting their home.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

Competing dens controlled regions of territory on their homeworld with the ruling group being known as the Overden.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Their cities were actually a collection of several dens with each specializing in a skill or craft. These dens supported and aided each other by way of a complicated system of bartering and favor exchanges.<ref name="UAA" />

====Material culture and technology====
{{Quote|Selonians are fierce. Warrior's blood flows through our veins.|Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
Though they maintained a seemingly primitive existence, the Selonians were in fact an information age level civilization.<ref name="AE" /> They were, in fact, considered technologically on par to galactic standards with their dens linked through computer networks and rapid transit systems.<ref name="UAA" />

Their industrial capacity was also able to help feed the ravenous production needs of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] who the Selonians provided with high-tech components.<ref name="UAA" /> They had mastered shipbuilding technology and even created starships capable of traversing their home system.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Selonians had possessed the ability for space travel for many years, though their reluctance to do so had more to do with their mindset.<ref name="AE" /> As they had little desire to go beyond the Corellian system, the Selonians did not construct [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] for their vessels.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

[[File:Selonian_warrior-SoF.jpg|thumb|right|170px|A Selonian warrior]]
Selonian warriors, who were almost always female, created their own [[Selonian glaive|personal glaives]], in a manner similar to a Jedi's creation of their lightsaber.<ref name="UAA" /> However, during the [[Galactic War]], some warriors of [[Murthil's den]] made use of [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], or a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] during combat.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

====Interspecies relationships====
{{Quote|Republic, Empire... politics mean nothing to Selonians. We fight because you invade our home.|Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
A select number of Selonians were specifically trained to deal with aliens and Humans.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> These individuals were known to integrate themselves into Human societies where they put their carefully learned mannerisms and attitudes at work with aliens in order to interact with them better.<ref name="AE" />

The Human-centric Empire, in an effort to spread xenophobia among the Human population of the Corellian system, spread propaganda saying that Selonians were warlike and prone to violence. Few Humans from the system believed it, however, as the species hadn't been warlike in centuries and the two races co-existed in relative peace.<ref name="UAA" />

However, several Selonian groups were known for xenophobia, including the [[Overden]], [[Absolutists]], and [[Sacorrian Triad]].<ref name="UAA" />

====Language====
{{Quote|We Selonians ''can'' do lying, but we have no practice at it. We see it is a bad thing. Not a little bad thing, as with you, but a ''big'' bad thing, like murder.|[[Dracmus]]|<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
The species had their own [[Language/Legends|language]], [[Mandaba/Legends|Mandaba]], which was both spoken and written, though those members of their kind that were accustomed to speaking to outsiders were able to speak in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. Selonians also spoke a modified language among their dens which was not diminished by auditory echoes in their burrows.<ref name="UAA" />

Etiquette included [[Lord/Legends|ladies]] of some fashion.

Some common Selonian names were Cavisek, Maronea and Vissica.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Patience, Major. The Selonians are fierce warriors, and those tunnels are their nest. Your men wouldn't survive five minutes.''"<br />"''You don't know the half of it. I've seen holos of a gang that attacked the tunnels... clawed to pieces...|[[Darth Decimus]] and [[Darbin Sull]]|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
[[File:Selonian.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Han Solo battles [[Dracmus]], a Selonian]]
Selonians were seemingly natives to the planet Selonia within the Corellian system. The species were believed to had origins from an [[Wikipedia:otter|aquatic mammal species that lived in riverside burrows]] which they still used as their homes. Many Selonians also lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], with additional dens on planets scattered throughout the galaxy. Much of the criss-crossed tunnels on both Selonia and Corellia were actually the result of the hard work of the Selonians.<ref name="AE" /> The tunnels on Corellia were in fact known as the [[Selonian Tunnels]]. At some unknown point, a den of Selonians were exiled from their homeworld for a dishonorable act which led to their banishment to the world of [[Sacorria]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded Corellia and the rebel Corellians allied themselves with the Selonians who allowed the use of their tunnels to combat the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] offensive.

Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], the [[Afarathu]] sect terrorized the Corellian system for many years until their destruction in [[380 BBY/Legends|380 BBY]] at the hands of [[Keiran Halcyon]]. Another notable group of Selonians were the [[Doloria]] who were a cult of assassins founded by the Selonians of Sacorria and operated in the Corellian sector. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Selonian [[Pumav]] came seventh in the quadruped race and seventh in the biped during [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]]. One known Selonian who left his peoples society was [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] after he was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] leading to him joining the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Their lack of involvement in galactic affairs saved the Selonians from domination during the [[Rise of the Empire era]].<ref name="UAA" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used the near forgotten actions of the Afaranathu to spread fear in the Corellian system. In addition, they attempted to cultivate xenophobia amongst the Human populations of the system by using propaganda to spread the belief that the Selonians were a war-like species that were prone to violence though this was never believed by the Corellians. 

A Selonian was known to work for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a chef.

Following the destruction of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Selonians became more sympathetic to the plight of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after seeing the destructive actions of the Empire. After the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the glimmer of hope inspired the Selonians to fully embrace the Rebel cause in the resultant [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TPoV">{{SonyCite|url=tradingcardgame/cardsets.vm?set=tpov|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Trading Card Game: The Price of Victory}}</ref> 

The Selonians were swept up in the power struggles that broke out in the Corellian system following the collapse of Imperial rule leading to the very real prospect that their world would be destroyed in the process. This caused them to become even more withdrawn from other cultures, even amongst the ones inhabiting their home system. However, the resultant shock to Selonian society led to a rare few individuals seeking to change their culture so that they could deal with other species more honestly.<ref name="UAA" /> Certain Selonians still supported the Rebel Alliance and in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Lady [[Leyli]] who had ties to the Tralus [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], provided information to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] on an Imperial outpost on the planet.

Also in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY,]] a female Selonian named [[Chertyl Ruluwoor (Selonian)|Chertyl Ruluwoor]] entered [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]] as part of a transfer program. That year, officer [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] escorted to her the [[Annual CorSec Awards Ball]] and the two shared a brief but passionate romance. However, their relationship was complicated by both different long term relationship goals and incomparable body chemistry, which left both with uncomfortable rashes. They parted amicably and remained good friends.

After the emergence of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the system was represented by only a single member which was met with protests by both the Selonians and the Drall. By [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], radical groups such as the [[Absolutists]] and the [[Overden]] emerged on Selonia which had secretly allied itself with the [[Sacorrian Triad]] in their bid to gain independence from the New [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. This led to the [[Corellian Crisis]] where the Overden worked alongside the [[Human League]] and the [[Drallist Front|Drallists]] to take over the system. The separatist Selonians had to battle loyalist members of their kind such as the [[Republicanists]] who included the [[Hunchuzuc Den]] which brought about an undeclared civil war. During these hostilities, the rebel Selonians fired their [[planetary repulsor]] which left the [[Bakura/Legends|Bakuran]] starship ''[[Watchkeeper]]'' a ruined wreck. By the time of the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Corellian Crisis)|Battle of Centerpoint]], the Selonian loyalist [[Dracmus]] along with [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] were successful in getting the aid of the Overden which ended the conflict.
